kaikki_vikisozluk.t: Borrowed from Middle Persian [Term?], and denominal verb. Persian زرکش (zarkaš), whence Middle Armenian զառքաշ (zaṙkʻaš), Middle Georgian ზარქაში (zarkaši).
g: to adorn, to decorate, to embellish
